survey: The card shows an open envelope with a fan of photos. The envelope is seen almost straight on and turned slightly clockwise. Its front pocket is a trapezoid whose side folds meet at a shallow V in the middle. The back flap is open, and its tip shows above the photos at the top centre. Four or five photos with white borders sit inside the pocket and fan out a little. Each one is a flat rectangle with even borders, and each is cut off cleanly by the top edge of the pocket. The round postmark, the wavy cancel lines and the scalloped house stamp are printed flat on the front at lower right. They tilt with the envelope, and the postmark's rings are near-circles, which fits a surface that faces the camera. The envelope floats in front of a radial background with no ground, so there is no contact to check. The envelope edges, the fold lines and the photo edges all agree on one nearly frontal view.
